name.en: Rhenium: Original Don't Starve Together Systems Tasks
name.zh: Rhenium：《饥荒联机版》原创系统工程题

description.en: Ten independently authored hard engineering tasks built only around base-game Don't Starve Together APIs, prefabs, components, and assets.
description.zh: 十道独立设计的高难度工程题，仅使用《饥荒联机版》原版 API、prefab、组件与资源。

title.zh: 确定性战斗目标仲裁器

summary.en: Choose combat targets from ordered threat events with decay, taunt leases, invalidation, deterministic ties, and reload-safe state.
summary.zh: 根据有序威胁事件、衰减、嘲讽租约、目标失效、确定性平局和可重载状态选择战斗目标。

brief.en: Implement a pure threat arbiter and a master-simulation component. Damage events carry per-source monotonic sequence numbers. Threat decays from event time, taunt leases temporarily override normal ranking, invalid or dead targets disappear immediately, and stable target IDs break ties. Integrate attacked/death/onremove events and the base-game health and combat components.
brief.zh: 实现纯威胁仲裁器和主模拟组件。伤害事件携带按攻击源单调递增的序号；威胁从事件时间开始衰减，嘲讽租约暂时覆盖普通排名，非法或死亡目标立即移除，并用稳定目标 ID 处理平局。接入 attacked/death/onremove 事件及原版 health、combat 组件。

en: Export Arbiter.new(options), Arbiter.load(data, options, now), observe(entity, now), add_threat(source_id, target_id, amount, seq, now), taunt(request_id, source_id, target_id, duration, now), remove(target_id, now), choose(source_id, now), tick(now), snapshot(now), and save(now).
Validate identifiers, finite non-negative time, positive finite threat, strictly increasing integer sequence per source/target stream, and known live entities.

Each source/target entry decays linearly on its own from its last accepted threat event: max(0, value - decay_per_second * (now - updated_at)); a new event first decays that entry to the event time, then adds the amount. Remove zero-threat rows without depending on tick frequency.
Choose highest current threat, then oldest first-seen time, then lexical target ID; return fresh values.
A valid taunt lease overrides ranking until its exact expiry boundary; duplicate request IDs are stable and stale leases cannot revive removed targets.
Removing or marking an entity dead clears its threat and taunt participation immediately while preserving sequence anti-replay state.
Save/load at a supplied now value preserves effective threat, leases, first-seen ordering, request history, and anti-replay state.

The server component derives attacker/target identity, listens and unsubscribes from attacked/death/onremove, periodically reconciles targets, validates health/combat, and calls combat:SetTarget only on the master simulation.
zh: 校验标识、有限非负时间、正有限威胁、按源/目标流严格递增的整数序号以及已知存活实体。
每个 source/target 条目从其最近一次被接受的威胁事件起独立线性衰减：max(0, value - decay_per_second * (now - updated_at))；新事件先把该条目衰减到事件时刻再累加；以与 tick 频率无关的方式移除零威胁项。
按当前最高威胁、最早首次出现时间、目标 ID 字典序选择，并返回新值。
有效嘲讽租约在精确到期边界前覆盖排名；重复 request ID 稳定，旧租约不能复活已移除目标。
移除或死亡会立即清除威胁与嘲讽参与，同时保留序号防重放状态。
按给定 now 保存加载时保留有效威胁、租约、首次出现顺序、请求历史和防重放状态。
服务端推导攻击者/目标身份，监听并注销 attacked/death/onremove，周期性协调目标，验证 health/combat，并仅在主模拟调用 combat:SetTarget。

en: The attacked callback receives data.attacker, data.damage, data.weapon, and data.stimuli; attacker may be nil.
Validate target.components.health and not health:IsDead() before source.components.combat:SetTarget(target), then inspect combat.target because SetTarget performs base-game validation.
Listen for attacked/death/onremove with saved callbacks and remove each callback using the same function object.
DoPeriodicTask(period, fn, initialdelay) returns a task that must be canceled during component removal.
The server component exposes Track(entity, stable_id), ObserveDamage(source, target, amount, seq), Taunt, Reconcile(source), and OnSave/OnLoad.
zh: attacked callback 的 data 含 attacker、damage、weapon、stimuli；attacker 可能为 nil。
调用 source.components.combat:SetTarget(target) 前检查 target.components.health 且未死亡；调用后核对 combat.target，因为原版仍会校验目标。
保存 attacked/death/onremove 的 callback，并以相同函数对象逐一注销。
DoPeriodicTask(period, fn, initialdelay) 返回 task，组件移除时必须取消。
服务端组件公开 Track(entity, stable_id)、ObserveDamage(source, target, amount, seq)、Taunt、Reconcile(source) 和 OnSave/OnLoad。

en: Duplicate and out-of-order damage is ignored.
Decay and tie-breaking are independent of table iteration and tick frequency.
Taunts expire at the exact boundary.
Death/removal cannot be undone by delayed events.
The dedicated server verifies real combat events, SetTarget, expiry, cleanup, and reload.
zh: 重复与乱序伤害被忽略。
衰减和平局不依赖表遍历或 tick 频率。
死亡/移除不能被延迟事件撤销。
专服验证真实战斗事件、SetTarget、过期、清理与重载。

hidden_cases: duplicate and out of order threat is rejected
decay is independent of tick frequency
ties use first seen then lexical id
save load preserves effective threat and defensive state
server_cases: real combat component receives chosen target
